beats.shot: side view of Omar in a high plank
beats.does: holds his body in one straight line from head to heels
beats.says: Straight line from head to heels.

beats.does: lowers down with his elbows angled about 45 degrees from his body
lowers until his chest is just above the floor
presses back up, body still in one line
beats.says: Push the floor away, hips stay level.
Ten good ones beat thirty bad ones.
